TC1.Feature: Register default and masked write-read verification
TC1.Test Description: Verifies PCIe SII RC register default values and checks masked write/read behavior using multiple data patterns.
TC1.Remarks: Unreadable addresses are skipped. Unwritable addresses are not written or verified. Addresses in the skip list are fully skipped. Default checks are skipped for the PHY reset control register. A soft reset sequence exists but is not executed.
TC1.Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Read each register in the list and compare to its documented default, skipping the PHY reset control if present and skipping unreadable entries.
2) For each data pattern, write the pattern to each writable and not-skipped register.
3) Read each such register and compare the value to the expected masked result that merges writable bits from the pattern with preserved default bits.
4) Record any mismatches and report overall pass only if no mismatches occur.
TC1.Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Default values: For each readable and not-skipped register, the read value matches its documented default; pass if none differ.
2) Masked write/read: For each writable, readable, and not-skipped register across all data patterns, the read value equals the masked combination of the pattern and default; pass if all match.
3) Overall: Pass only when no default or write/read mismatches are recorded.
TC1.Hidden_Test_Description: Test validates reset default values and masked write-read behavior for PCIe0 SII RC registers using table-driven arrays.
